subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The flowers were being plucked by the children in the garden.

options.text: The children were plucking the flowers in the garden.
The children are plucking the flowers in the garden.
The children had been plucking the flowers in the garden.
The children was plucking the flowers in the garden.

solution:
The correct answer is** ****"****The children were plucking the flowers in the garden."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Past Continuous Tense **and in** Passive Voice.**
 
• The rule for changing a **Past Continuous Tense** from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• **Structure: **
 
 
• **Subject + was/were + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__**
 
• **Object + was/were + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ **
 
 
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• *Esha was singing a song.** ***(Active Voice)**
 
• *A song was being sung by Esha.**** *(Passive Voice)****​​**
 
 
 
 
 
• **The subject** of the given sentence is 'Flowers**'.​​**
 
• **The object** of the given sentence is** 'children.' **
 
• **The subject** will be put in place of** the object **and** the object **will be put in place of **the subject.**
 
• **'Were being plucked'** will be changed into **'were plucking'. **
 
• **"Children"** is a plural subject so we must **"were"** with it.
 
• The correct option 1 follows all the above rules and correctly expresses the given sentence in active voice.
